verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer can analyze data from Snowflake, Databricks, Google Sheets, Salesforce and other sources. It can also process CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF and media files in a sandboxed VM with Python, and turn results into spreadsheets, slide decks and documents, which covers the core of getting AI-generated insights from your data. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how analysis insights and proactive suggestions are surfaced, explicit evidence of 'suggestions' as distinct from task output, and independent or hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality.
